scientific_integrity: The proof is elementary finite-group Fourier analysis; finite exact-integer tests corroborate, and no computational extrapolation is used.
scientific_limitations: All-prime proof concerns only C_(p^2) x C_p, complete coset data for maximal cyclic subgroups, and positive direction-constant weights; no independent validation or exhaustive priority determination.
title: Maximal-cyclic tomography on the first nonhomocyclic rank-two prime-power torus
